correctness.rationale: Top caps of powers and bottom cups of powers grow by inclusion. Equal ranks force equal cap/cup sets and hence the same uniquely ordered through-strand matching. A nonstable step loses at least two through strands; any nonidentity diagram starts at rank at most n-2. An explicit gluing induction for the unique-cap diagrams gives s(c_i,j)=1+floor(|i-j|/2), ranks n-2k through stabilization, and exactly the indicated two/six extremizers. All 6916 diagrams of n=2..9 and every one-cap intermediate power were checked from the actual embedded verifier; the all-size proof does not rely on finite enumeration.
